$comment: Held-out needs quoted word for word from real sources that predate the tags (both sketch gap lists, the briefs, the marks' gaps.json), with the file and line in the singularity repo. The same 44 items as the `heldout` split of find-bench.json (frozen at 6f378f68 before any scoring; ranker untouched since a417753e), extracted here with line numbers per the manager's rule on diddit #4161. Never tune on this file. `npm run find:bench -- --file scripts/find-bench-real.json`.

needs.need: Right side: avatar + user name ("Peter") account menu, instead of the "3 DOING" chip and "? v" menu.
Search: "Filter tasks", full width, flush under the toolbar.
Group headers: compact flush rows (name left, boxed count right), thin dividers, no tall banded headers, no gaps between groups, no visible +/- button.
Cards: full-width list rows, not boxed cards. Line 1: title (ellipsis) + owner on the right. Line 2: progress bar (solid = done, hatched = in progress). No status pill, no "n/m steps", no time.
Title large on its own line; owner a boxed chip top-right ("Anna"), not an "OWNER: ANA" line.
Complete-step control WITH hotkey stays (Peter: "I forgot a hot key complete button. Add that"); place it on the active step card, not a full-width bar.

Steps as a flow diagram, not a table: done steps are small cards (name + progress bar) stacked vertically; arrows between labelled with the gap time ("18 min", "1h 2 min", "3 min"); the active step is a large card (name, long description, "Est 12 min" / "Act 3:02", progress bar); an arrow on to the next step, a small card with its estimate ("est 2 min").
"Logs" heading only: no line count, no TIME / MESSAGE column headers.
Entries: time left, message right, wrapping across lines; airy rows, no table grid.
Full height; the sidebar list scrolls with a visible scrollbar.
Counts centred in their boxes.
The title field occupies the title's box (same left edge, font, baseline), grows with its content up to the available width and never hides the start of the text.
Toolbar: one tight row of two equal buttons, sort first ("▽ Oldest": icon + current value), then "Create" (not "+ New task").

Rows: line 1 title (ellipsis) + warning-triangle icon on the right when it has an incident; line 2 start date (YYYY-MM-DD) left, duration ("27h") right. No verdict pill, no asset on the row (the asset is in the detail header).
Right side, before the user: the time range / current time ("2026-10-01 12:00") and a count chip with an icon ("7", timeframes with incidents).
One header line: title, then range "2026-10-01 07:15 to 10-03 15:13 (63h)", asset ("PL-A") right-aligned. No ASSET/START/END/DURATION/VERDICT label stack.
Action row: a compact "Approve" button at the left of a ruled toolbar row (not a full-width bar); fail/investigate beside it by the same pattern; hotkeys as now.
Charts: two columns of large tiles, title "Fan set point (FAN_I_SP)"; left and bottom axes only (no frame, no expand icon); y-axis unit label ("rpm"); time ticks on x.
Hover: a vertical line on every chart at the same time, plus a value tooltip box near the cursor ("2000 rpm") on the hovered chart.
A group emptied by review collapses.
A chip shows how many timeframes in the filtered list have incidents.

A time range selector is shown (eg. 2026-10-01 08:13 PDT - 2026-10-03 18:21) - if it is zoomed, the exact time range is shown (eg. 2026-10-01 13:13 to 14:32). If zoomed there is an x on the time range that restores the last timeframe selected.
Dragging a range zooms all visible charts to that range.
There is a time series chart for each metric. the Charts have a min/max width. If there is enough horizontal space, you can flex tile the charts.
A search field sits at the top of the rail. Typing filters the rail to tasks whose title matches.
Its steps are shown as a table: status, name, started, completed.
A log panel sits beside the detail with a "logs" header and one line per log entry of the selected step, with its time.
A status chip shows how many tasks are Doing, as a word and a number.
open the help dialog, which lists every key with a key cap
open settings (Theme, Localization, Sharing tabs)
The rail can be sorted (newest first, oldest first, by title) and can be collapsed away to give the detail the full width.
Incidents shows a table of identified problem spots that link back to the timeframes browser
Settings and sign-in live in the user menu.
GroupedTaskList: grouped, sortable, collapsible card list with counts in headers and a selected id
LogLineList: a time plus text list; composed from BaseTable with dateTimeCol and textCol
SelectedRowTable: BaseTable only has highlighted (hover look); a canonical selected-row state is missing
CountedTitle: title Tasks, count 7, noun tasks
StepProgressBar: done number, total number
LocaleSwitcher: SettingsModal Localization tab
RetrospectiveScreen: stub; shows time per step across finished tasks, slow steps, what to change
TaskCard: title left, status right, owner bottom-left, time bottom-right, selected boolean
FluidInspectorThreePanel: leftPanelWidth 22vw clamped 240..360 (fluid list), rightPanelWidth 320 wide inspector for the logs table
EditableTitleControlled: Escape inside the field cancels internally, so the store's editing flag stays true until the next edit
TaskStatusChip: status History | Recent | Doing | Todo
